newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Saudi Aramco enters talks to buy Petrogal stake.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco enters talks to buy Petrogal stake.

text.p: Saudi oil company Saudi Aramco has written to Petrogal-Petroleos de Portugal to say it planned to enter direct talks with the Portuguese company to buy a stake of about 35 percent, a source involved in the process said.
If Saudi Aramco buys the stake, it will become a direct shareholder in Petrogal, alongside Petrocontrol, a private group that now controls 45 percent.

Under the government's privatisation plan, the state would retain a 10 percent "golden share" in Petrogal, 20 percent would be floated on the market and the remaining 70 percent would be held equally by Saudi Aramco and Petrocontrol, the source said.
The source added that Petrocontrol would sell off a 10 percent stake but it was not yet agreed to whom.
Market sources said JP Morgan had valued Petrogal at around 280 billion escudos and Merrill Lynch had valued the company at around 220 billion.
